sloka: एवंप्रभावो लवणः शूलं चैव तथाविधम् ।श्रुत्वा प्रमाणं काकुत्स्थ त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः ।। ७.६१.२२ ॥
transliteration: evaṁprabhāvo lavaṇaḥ śūlaṁ caiva tathāvidham ।śrutvā pramāṇaṁ kākutstha tvaṁ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ ।। 7.61.22 ॥

translations.english: Having heard of Lavana's power and the nature of his trident, O Rama, you are our ultimate refuge and authority.
